annotations.title: List the browser tools on vaultan.app

description: Lists every file tool on vaultan.app with what it does and its address: merge, split, compress, sign, redact, rotate and number PDFs, images to PDF, PDF to JPG, remove photo location, blur part of a photo, and a file converter. They run in the web browser on the person's own device: files are not uploaded and no account is needed.
